Tool call input: {'knowledge_bases': ['chemistry'], 'search_rounds_budget': 2, 'search_target': 'Determine the optimal coupling partner among the three specified heteroaryl candidates for the reaction: bulky biaryl phosphine ligand, acetonitrile solvent, 6-bromoisoquinoline-like aryl bromide, KOH. Compare heteroaryl pinacol boronate ester Cc1ccc2c(cnn2C2CCCCO2)c1B1OC(C)(C)C(C)(C)O1, potassium organotrifluoroborate Cc1ccc2c(cnn2C2CCCCO2)c1[B-](F)(F)F.[K+], and corresponding aryl bromide. Identify likely Suzuki-Miyaura partner and choose the reagent most consistent with maximizing yield under these conditions.'}

Choose the **heteroaryl pinacol boronate ester** as the Suzuki–Miyaura coupling partner; use **6-bromoisoquinoline as the electrophile**. The corresponding heteroaryl bromide is not the boron coupling partner in this pairing.

The closest ORD records use the same pinacol boronate with an isoquinolinyl iodide. One record lists KOH, acetonitrile, and a bulky biaryl phosphine/Pd system and reports 99.0% yield. This supports the boronate choice, but it is an analogue—not an exact head-to-head comparison under the stated conditions.
